scope: Agency catalogs and profile; program/access/audit subscopes have separate sync-program.json, sync-access.json and sync-audit-gwcoa.json receipts
finalContracts: Attachment type names and descriptions are required bilingually; descriptions preserve whitespace and reject null characters.

Document templates support Agreement, Amendment and Closeout record types, bilingual names/descriptions and language files, DOCX or HTML kind, compatible native/PDF output, 10 MiB per-file limit and same-Agency/type per-language name uniqueness.

Document template kind is immutable; edits can replace either language file. Failed replacement transactions preserve saved files, while failed post-save reload must be retried before creating another record.
Agency Workflow Flow is a separate read-only diagram route. Unsaved changes or a pending mutation block switching between editor and diagram; draft save and publication remain distinct.
Agency Contributor can delete eligible draft Review Sets, Recommendation Sets, Workflows and Data Collections; general catalog Manager wording was narrowed to avoid denying supported actions.
Review member checklist-failure setting makes Fail negative; assessment numeric results strictly below a configured threshold are negative. Equality is not a threshold failure.
omissions: GWCOA and Approval Behalf database column renames preserve existing user behavior; user guide labels avoid internal column names.
Agency guided-help catalog storage and new UI help targets belong to the guided-help worker.
Status constraint/table corrections preserve documented lifecycle rules; no additional behavior claim added.
Localized toast and shared button refactors do not change documented operations.
Program, schema, access and audit/GWCOA changes are delegated to nonoverlapping workers and recorded separately.
verification: Source and paired-doc review only. Required repository generators, docs:check and builds are owned by the coordinator and have not been run by this worker.
